overview.name: taxonomy
overview.oneLiner: An open-source Next.js blogging platform with GitHub authentication, MDX docs, and Stripe Pro subscriptions.
overview.description:
Taxonomy is built with Next.js App Router, Prisma, NextAuth, and Stripe. Visitors browse public marketing pages, an MDX blog, and documentation, then sign in via GitHub OAuth or Postmark magic email links.

Authenticated authors manage their posts on a dashboard using an Editor.js rich-text editor. Free accounts can publish up to three posts before upgrading to a Pro subscription through Stripe Checkout and webhooks.
overview.audience: Writers and developers looking for a modern SaaS starter or blogging platform.
overview.architecture: Server components in [[file:app/(dashboard)/dashboard/page.tsx]] and [[file:app/(editor)/editor/[postId]/page.tsx]] verify the user via [[sym:lib/session.ts#getCurrentUser]] and read directly from [[file:lib/db.ts]]. Mutations and Stripe billing flow through App Router API handlers like [[file:app/api/posts/route.ts]] and [[file:app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts]].
gaps: No automated tests found in the repository.
No rate limiting detected on API route handlers.

file:prisma/schema.prisma.text:
// This is your Prisma schema file,
// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "mysql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Account {
  id                String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId            String
  type              String
  provider          String
  providerAccountId String
  refresh_token     String?  @db.Text
  access_token      String?  @db.Text
  expires_at        Int?
  token_type        String?
  scope             String?
  id_token          String?  @db.Text
  session_state     String?
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map(name: "created_at")
  updatedAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map(name: "updated_at")

  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])
  @@map(name: "accounts")
}

model Session {
  id           String   @id @default(cuid())
  sessionToken String   @unique
  userId       String
  expires      DateTime
  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@map(name: "sessions")
}

model User {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  name          String?
  email         String?   @unique
  emailVerified DateTime?
  image         String?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now()) @map(name: "created_at")
  updatedAt     DateTime  @default(now()) @map(name: "updated_at")

  accounts Account[]
  sessions Session[]
  Post     Post[]

  stripeCustomerId       String?   @unique @map(name: "stripe_customer_id")
  stripeSubscriptionId   String?   @unique @map(name: "stripe_subscription_id")
  stripePriceId          String?   @map(name: "stripe_price_id")
  stripeCurrentPeriodEnd DateTime? @map(name: "stripe_current_period_end")

  @@map(name: "users")
}

model VerificationToken {
  identifier String
  token      String   @unique
  expires    DateTime

  @@unique([identifier, token])
  @@map(name: "verification_tokens")
}

model Post {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  title     String
  content   Json?
  published Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map(name: "created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @default(now()) @map(name: "updated_at")
  authorId  String

  author User @relation(fields: [authorId], references: [id])

  @@map(name: "posts")
}

Where do we handle Stripe webhooks?.text: Stripe webhooks are handled in [[file:app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts]] by the [[sym:app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts#POST]] handler.

It verifies the `Stripe-Signature` header using [[sym:lib/stripe.ts#stripe]] (`STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET`) and handles `checkout.session.completed` and `invoice.payment_succeeded`, updating subscription fields on [[db:prisma:User]].

answer.markdown:
Stripe webhooks are handled in [[file:app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts]] by the [[sym:app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts#POST]] handler.
